description: Implementation of the SimpleBuffer class for managing byte buffers, including methods for reading, writing, reserving space, and releasing buffer slices.

classes.name: SimpleBuffer
classes.description: A class for managing a resizable byte buffer with read/write capabilities.

methods.name: SimpleBuffer::SimpleBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a specified size.

methods.name: SimpleBuffer::Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer, expanding it if necessary.

methods.name: SimpleBuffer::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into provided memory.

methods.name: SimpleBuffer::Reserve
methods.description: Ensures the buffer has enough space, reallocating if needed.

methods.name: SimpleBuffer::AdvanceReadablePtr
methods.description: Advances the read pointer by a specified amount.

methods.name: SimpleBuffer::AdvanceWritablePtr
methods.description: Advances the write pointer by a specified amount.

methods.name: SimpleBuffer::ReleaseAsSlice
methods.description: Releases the buffer contents as a slice and resets the buffer.
